steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: D.O.S. in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Check Door Opening System operation during Service Diagnostics cycle (auto door open interval).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check Door Opening System operation during Service Diagnostics cycle (auto door open interval).

steps.title: Set up DC voltage test
steps.body: Remove outer door to access control. Set voltmeter to DC. Connect leads to test pads P9-1 and P9-2 on control board.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove outer door to access control. Set voltmeter to DC. Connect leads to test pads P9-1 and P9-2 on control board.

steps.title: Continue after Service Diagnostics entry
steps.body: Service Diagnostics should be available (1-2-3 entry, press Key #2, close door to start). Continue with D.O.S. bench checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Refer to Component Testing; use Service Diagnostics Cycle for live load verification.

steps.title: 12 VDC at P9-1 & P9-2 during D.O.S. interval?
steps.body: Plug in power. Start Service Diagnostics Cycle. At the D.O.S. interval, measure DC between P9-1 and P9-2. Expect 12 VDC ± 5%.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Plug in power. Start Service Diagnostics Cycle. At the D.O.S. interval, measure DC between P9-1 and P9-2. Expect 12 VDC ± 5%.

steps.title: Replace DOS module
steps.body: Control output verified — replace Door Opening System (D.O.S.) module and retest.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Control output verified — replace Door Opening System (D.O.S.) module and retest.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.body: No DC drive at P9 during D.O.S. interval — replace control board and retest.
steps.oemOutcome: No DC drive at P9 during D.O.S. interval — replace control board and retest.

steps.title: D.O.S. verified
steps.body: Door Opening System drive verified — reassemble and run Service Diagnostics to confirm auto door open.
steps.oemOutcome: Door Opening System drive verified — reassemble and run Service Diagnostics to confirm auto door open.
